spec.name: GoldDualSessionRangeExpansion
spec.hypothesis: XAUUSD exhibits persistent intraday volatility clustering where the London session establishes an initial range that is frequently expanded or retested during the New York overlap. Institutional order flow often uses the London range as a liquidity pool; when NY volume enters, price breaks this range with momentum driven by cross-session position adjustments. The losing side consists of retail traders fading the breakout without recognizing the session-specific volume regime shift.
spec.entry_logic: Enter long when current 4h bar closes above London session high AND bar is within NY session AND ATR > threshold. Enter short when current 4h bar closes below London session low AND bar is within NY session AND ATR > threshold. Requires no prior position active.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss set at max(5.0, atr * sl_mult) USD points from entry. Take profit set at max(8.0, atr * tp_mult) USD points from entry. Both distances strictly positive.
filters: London session range must have completed (at least 1 closed 4h bar after London close)
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Extended Asian-range consolidation with no London/NY expansion, or major central bank announcements causing gap-driven invalidation of session ranges.

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
